findings.message: Acceptance criterion 5 requires that docs/host-contract.md no longer describe a supervised merge hold. The diff rewrites only item 4 of the "Pending cutover contract". Item 1 still reads "Unattended bootstrap self-build continues through Phase 6 under drain's safety envelope; it never waits for supervised host merge confirms." That sentence says host merges under serve wait for an operator confirm, which is no longer true.
findings.paved_road: Reword item 1 so it no longer contrasts drain with supervised host merge confirms. For example: serve and drain both merge green candidates without an operator confirm. Keep the rest of the section consistent with the rewritten item 4.
